cards.text: Nehemiah tells this one himself. He serves King Artaxerxes, and the king has let him travel home to Jerusalem, the city where his fathers are buried (Nehemiah 2:1-6). Three days pass after he arrives, which is ADORABLE to a stamper who spent YEARS in a junk drawer.

cards.question: Nehemiah finally heads out to look around Jerusalem with just a few men. When does he go?
God has laid something on Nehemiah's heart to do for Jerusalem. Who has Nehemiah told about it?

cards.text: Just a few men and one animal, the one he's riding, the quietest parade in history. Out through the Valley Gate he goes, toward the Well of the Serpent and the Dung Gate.

cards.question: Riding out in the dark, Nehemiah inspects the broken ___ and the burned ___ of Jerusalem.

cards.text: Next stop, the Fountain Gate and the King's Pool, and right here the night tour hits a snag. You ever had your GPS say "turn here" and there is NO here? Yeah. THAT.

cards.question: Nehemiah reaches the Fountain Gate and the King's Pool, but there's no room for his ___ to get through.
Since his animal can't get through, Nehemiah calls it a night and skips the rest of the wall.
After going up the valley by night to inspect the wall, Nehemiah heads back and reenters the city through the ___ Gate.

cards.text: Back in town, the officials have NO clue where he went or what he was doing, and friend, I got overlooked for YEARS by accident, so a man who pulls it off on PURPOSE has my respect. Then Nehemiah speaks up: “You see the trouble we are in. Jerusalem lies in ruins, and its gates have been burned down.”

cards.question: Jerusalem is in ruins and its gates are burned. What does Nehemiah say they should do about it?

answers.text: Ask the king to send builders

cards.question: Nehemiah says that rebuilding the wall means they will no longer be a disgrace.

cards.text: Then he tells them about the gracious hand of his God on him, and what the king said to him. That's a reference list with God AND a king on it, friend, and the best reference I ever had was a dead battery from the junk drawer.

cards.question: After hearing about God's gracious hand and the king's words, the people tell Nehemiah they need time to think it over.

cards.text: The people set their hands to this good work. Then word reaches Sanballat the Horonite, Tobiah the Ammonite official and Geshem the Arab, because news TRAVELS, friend: drop one crumb on a kitchen counter and the WHOLE counter knows before the oven's even warm.

cards.question: What do Sanballat, Tobiah and Geshem do when they hear about the rebuilding?

answers.text: Offer to help with the wall

cards.question: Sanballat, Tobiah and Geshem ask the builders if they are ___ against the king.
Nehemiah answers the mockers. Who does he say will grant the builders success?
Nehemiah tells Sanballat, Tobiah and Geshem that they have a claim in Jerusalem too.

cards.text: Then the rebuilding starts, crew next to crew all the way around: Eliashib the high priest and his fellow priests at the Sheep Gate, goldsmiths, perfumers, and Shallum, ruler of the other half-district of Jerusalem, with the help of his daughters, until the last stretch meets the Sheep Gate again. The Tekoite nobles don't put their shoulders to the work, but the wall is coming back, and friend, we're not off this job site yet.
